purpose: New scenes frozen before the supplemental model run; the question and resolution are unchanged. Labels describe the language of visible body text, not private user intent.

messages: 航班改到明天早上了，我们今晚住哪里？
机场附近有家酒店，可以坐班车过去。
Our flight moved to tomorrow. Where can we stay?
There is a hotel near the airport with a shuttle.
这道菜需要先把土豆煮熟吗？
不用，切薄一点，直接放进锅里炒。
Should I boil the potatoes before cooking this?
No, slice them thinly and add them to the pan.
请问这套房子什么时候可以看房？
周六上午十点以后都可以，提前联系我就行。
When would it be possible to view the apartment?
Any time after ten on Saturday. Please call first.
包裹显示已经签收，可是前台没有收到。
我去问一下快递员，稍后回复你。
Tracking says delivered, but reception has nothing.
I will check with the courier and get back to you.
昨天那场演出最喜欢哪首歌？
最后那首，现场的鼓声特别有感染力。
Which song did you enjoy most at the concert?
The final one. The live drums were incredible.
最近跑步的时候总觉得配速不太稳定。
可以先放慢一点，保持呼吸均匀。
My pace has been rather uneven on recent runs.
Try slowing down and keeping your breathing steady.
这笔报销还缺哪张发票？
出租车那张还没上传，其他材料已经齐了。
Which receipt is missing from my expense claim?
Only the taxi receipt. Everything else is complete.
记得把阳台上的衣服收进来。
知道了，外面好像马上要下雨了。
Please remember to bring in the laundry.
I will. It looks as though it may rain soon.
CI 的 build 又失败了，日志里有 timeout。
先看看 Redis 的连接池是不是满了。
The 青云 deployment passed all the tests today.
Great. Please update the 星河 release notes next.
到了吗？
还没。
Are you here?
Not yet.
這份文件還需要補充什麼內容？
請加上測試結果，以及後續的工作安排。
We are using 繁體中文 as a sample document title.
The explanation and discussion are in English.
有人发来一句：请选择 English。
这只是邮件中的引文，我们继续讨论原来的安排。
The quoted message says: choose 中文.
That is just a quotation. Let's discuss our plans.
请随意选择中文或 English 回复。
You can reply in English or 中文.
